value: This U.S. industry comprises establishments primarily engaged in operating local and suburban ground passenger transit systems (except mixed mode transit systems, commuter rail systems, and buses and other motor vehicles) over regular routes and on regular schedules within a metropolitan area and its adjacent nonurban areas.
Cable car systems (except mixed mode), commuter
Light rail systems (except mixed mode), commuter
Monorail transit systems (except mixed mode), commuter
Street railway systems (except mixed mode), commuter
